notes: Shelf built from scratch (no old kinds). Three kinds: High-security lock cylinder (12 archetypes, ordered Protec2, MT5+, M3, MCS, then Twin, BiLock, Kaba expert, Interactive, Abloy Classic, Primus, Biaxial, plus EVVA 3KS which belt-list pickers treat as a peer); Practice & cutaway lock (types only, three Sparrows ranges as models, LPU rule that cutaways count White belt noted); Lock pick set (tool types in t, three maker set-lines as archetypes, Peterson/Covert as models). Years left blank where no retrieved page confirmed them (BiLock, Kaba expert, Sparrows/SouthOrd/Peterson founding). Belt grades come from the LPU karatebelts list and lpubelts.com pages; generations from Lockwiki. Left out: DOM ix, Kromer Protector, Vachette and other black-belt European cylinders (no page retrieved this session); Wikipedia 'Abloy' redirects to Assa Abloy so Lockwiki is the Abloy brand source. No traditions: industrial products, no artisan tradition applies. Built-in multipoint locks stay with Home Fixtures per rules.
